query: Request to implement DreamID-Omni (dreamOmini) in the wrapper; feature request, no workflow problem or error.

desired.outcome: Community analysis (railep): DreamID-Omni is an Ovi variant (same layers, fp32 vs bf16; mmaudio + Wan 2.2 5B) so the existing Ovi workflow should run it; maintainer (kijai, quoted) stated he won't update the wrapper anymore, focusing on Comfy core — so no wrapper support is coming.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Reason architecturally that DreamID-Omni is an Ovi variant (same layers, fp32 vs bf16, mmaudio + Wan 2.2 5B) so the existing Ovi workflow covers it, and that the maintainer has abandoned the wrapper.
